name: Mamata Scheme
benefit:
- Rs.3,000 shall be given during the third trimester of the pregnancy of the mother till delivery on completing the following 5 conditions:

   1. Pregnancy registered at AWC/Mini AWC
   1. Received at least 2 antenatal checkup (ANC)
   1. Received IFA and calcium tablets.
   1. Received at least 1 TT vaccination (out of optimal 2)
   1. Received at least 1 counselling session at AWC/Village Healt
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Odisha.
   1. The scheme is primarily aimed at pregnant women. 
   1. Pregnant &amp; Lactating women of 19 years of age and above for the first two live births, except all Government/Public Sector Undertakings (Central and State) employees and their wives will be covered.
